comment: M17 command gallery fight, rendered, as a carried campaign run. Run with tools/qa_m17_carried.sh: the player resumes a validated M16 departure (server run-file test m16_departure_fixture_carries_an_earned_kit_into_m17) in the durable local child, on Assisted, carrying the Episode IV kit (Flechette selected, Scatter, Rail, Sniper, Repeater, Arc, Rocket, pools about half full, 72 health, 15 armour; Tack, Flechette and Repeater share one bullet pool, so the route changes guns as a player does rather than running the Flechette dry) rather than arriving with fists. A joined human clears the approach and the hall with the Flechette, then the ring with the Scatter, whose watch wakes into the hall as the hall falls, by searching toward its door while fighting rather than walking there unarmed; takes Kessel into custody with the ring's health on the way, and frames the Enforcer at the north rail and the east-gallery Clerk from the floor's threshold while the gallery watch is still at its posts; stepping onto the floor wakes it for the exposed stair and the sheltered stair's arrival, then the ordinary fight clears them with the Rail, any search it began is walked back to the console end of the deck, and the override is worked on the gallery from a walk that stays clear of the rail. The joined player's camera is first person throughout. Accurate-aim authoring route and art review, not fresh-player evidence.
